identity: No-training analytic finite-population chain witness, not old PPO replay or physical execution

source.selection: last stored state at t=1.0 after the first recorded five-step segment; the first physical disturbance lasts longer

frozen_design.command_origin: Three existing task-reference speeds, frozen before comparison
frozen_design.state_conditioning: Actor reads six-state-derived q,v,r and command; no task reference input
frozen_design.actor_fixed_action_map: f=.2v+3(c-v)+.1U sign_f; g=-3sin(q)-1.5r+.1U sign_g; u=U tanh([f+g,f-g]/U)
frozen_design.prediction_scope: One macro segment, not original 12-macro MPC horizon
frozen_design.replanning_anchor: All before/after scores use the same historical t=1.0 state, not a newly measured t=1.1 state
frozen_design.objective_semantics: Exact expected quadratic cost from first and second moments; differs from the main A5 default cost evaluated only on a mean trajectory, equally applied to all arms
frozen_design.J_U_ablation_scope: Normal directions of the entire lifted motion/input moment relation H; not only the deadline capacity inequality and not a full neural J-U implementation

local_surrogate.discretization: Exact ZOH of q=0 linearized affine model; w=0 nominal
local_surrogate.nonlinear_plant_difference: rdot error q-sin(q); no nonlinear physical predictions claimed

feature_representation.constraints: H b = h for every constructed path; N=H.T pinv(H H.T) H, P=I-N
feature_representation.unstructured_model: qU(phi)=qS(phi)+N phi; same parameter count, but intentionally more infeasible output freedom

model_virtual_step.ranking_invariance_scope: This construction shares H and task w across all candidates, so the same normal cost shift cannot reorder S/U candidates; this is not a general MPC ranking result

actor_credit.command_distribution: Only old winner command for every method; no command-distribution confound

actor_virtual_steps_and_exact_refits.readout_identity: Same exact analytic current-policy moment oracle for all methods, ideal sufficient-fit evaluation; no shared phi fitted and no model release performed

budget.historical_data_used: One already-published six-state endpoint; no new measurements
budget.note: Offline model propagation is counted and is not free physical data; exact finite population has no Monte Carlo/SNIS sampling error.

boundaries: No training or physical rollout; finite analytic categorical policy is not the old Gaussian PPO actor.
Finite known surrogate population is much easier than unknown-system/high-dimensional PPO data estimation.
Original task weights are preserved, but only one 0.1-second macro stage and three fixed commands are compared.
Unstructured output permits infeasible normal motion/input statistics and is a structural ablation, not a fair deployable performance competitor.
Gradient/nominal-cost differences alone do not establish improved physical feedback capability or long-horizon benefit.

Legacy exact_refit keys mean an exact analytic current-policy moment oracle shared by all methods. No shared phi+ is fitted or proven to represent all commands; the main algorithm's model-release step is not tested.
Every before/after candidate score is evaluated at the same historical t=1.0 anchor; no advanced measured state or actual replanning event occurs.
This instance uses exact expected quadratic cost from first/second moments, not the main A5 default mean-trajectory nominal cost; all comparisons use the same convention.

J-U relaxes the entire lifted motion/input moment normal relation, not only a deadline capacity constraint. All finite-tree actions already obey hardware bounds; no active resource-boundary learning effect is demonstrated.
